the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: induction on the torsion degree n: split off a prime factor via 0 -> M[l] -> M -> M' -> 0 and the long exact sequence, reducing to the prime annihilator case by the constructible-abelian lemma; replace Lambda by the F_l-algebra Lambda/lLambda since R^qf_* does not see the difference; resolve the finite module by finite free modules and use the finite cohomological dimension of f_* together with the spectral sequence of the total complex to reduce to R^qf_* of the coefficient ring itself; finally use the projection formula for mod-l proper pushforward to trade Rf_*Lambda for the derived tensor of Rf_*Z/lZ with Lambda, note modules over the field Z/lZ are flat, and conclude by tensoring a constructible sheaf with Lambda, the base case being the constant sheaf case lemma (source lines 4591-4668)
